name: Ecology and Evolutionary Biology PhD
detailsNote: Official available admissions process; published deadline is for Fall 2026, not Fall 2027. Independent interdisciplinary EEB degree, not departmental Ecology and Conservation Biology.

publishedDeadlines.label: Historical Fall 2026 consideration
publishedDeadlines.note: Explicit prior cycle; late evaluation only in special circumstances.

applicationFee.note: Central admissions explicitly says the $90 international fee cannot be waived. EEB advertises a generic need-based waiver contact, but does not establish international eligibility or an exception to the central rule. Confirm any department offer separately. Additional CAS processing charges apply.

english.note: Within 2 years; Home Edition/Essentials 8.5 accepted, MyBest/IELTS One Skill Retake not accepted. GRE Verbal 146/GMAT alternatives subject to department approval. Exemption: listed English-country citizenship or US accredited bachelor/master; department may be stricter. EEB requires legacy TOEFL Speaking 23 or IELTS Speaking 7, prefers 26/8; program describes Level 1 TA proof with Level 2 case-by-case.

documents: Statement of purpose naming faculty sponsor
requirements.note: Four-year bachelor equivalent; research aptitude through prior research/presentations/publications. Contact EEB core faculty sponsor before deadline; acceptance requires adviser agreement. General GRE not evaluated; Biology subject GRE optional.
